reference: Run-3 low-pT J/psi tag-and-probe with a ParkingSingleMuon event trigger external to the measured dimuon pair

campaign_inputs.run2024i_policy: Use one MINIv6NANOv15 production per primary dataset and exclude duplicated MINIv6NANOv15_v2 processing.
campaign_inputs.mc_campaign_note: The independent 90,099,004-event SPS double-J/psi to four-muon production supplies an external reference muon and a disjoint J/psi measurement pair.

binning_policy: Count the initial 4x5 grid and merge only by exact post-reduction summation when the effective MC fail count or fit stability does not support a bin.
target_selection: looseId; miniPFRelIso_all is not part of the probe pass/fail definition
denominator: reconstructed tracker muon with 5 < pT < 10 GeV and abs(eta) < 2.4, without a LooseID or mini-isolation requirement
tag: tight muon with pT > 5 GeV; no mini-isolation or trigger-object requirement is applied to either measured J/psi leg
trigger_object_bit_source: The parking paths have no path-specific NanoAOD TrigObj quality bit in CMSSW_15_0_X; the HLT is therefore made external to the measured pair through a third offline barrel muon.
reference_trigger_strategy: Data must fire a ParkingSingleMuon path and contain an additional tight barrel muon with pT > 12 GeV distinct from both measured J/psi legs. The identical disjoint offline topology is imposed on double-J/psi MC, while the parking HLT itself is data-only.
adoption_gates: data inputs are exclusively ParkingSingleMuon and no double-muon reference path is configured
the external reference muon is distinct from both measured J/psi legs in every selected pair
neither measured leg is trigger matched or required to pass isolation
probe pass/fail audit proves LooseID and mini-isolation are absent from the denominator
every adopted bin has effective MC fail count >= 10, with >= 20 preferred
simultaneous pass/fail fit convergence in every adopted bin
bin-by-bin scale-factor stability under fit-model, fit-window, binning, tag-selection, external-reference, and pileup variations
